usedFor: VATlayer checks VAT with “Validate VAT Number” and “Validate VAT and Price”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in Lemon Squeezy, then “Validate VAT and Price” in VATlayer
bestTemplate.why: A new order brings a VAT number to check, and the action returns its validity and price.

watchOut: “Validate VAT Number” checks one number at a time, so pass it a complete VAT number.
